exposure: Exposure to any ≥2 socioeconomic risk factors compared to none
cohort: 2879 women who participated in the IMPROvED birth cohort between 2013 and 2017 in Sweden, the Netherlands and Republic of Ireland.
finding: In this cohort study of women from high-income European countries, there was limited evidence for an association between individual-level socioeconomic factors and pregnancy and neonatal outcomes, with only a few significant associations observed among pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with middle level of income had reduced odds of emergency cesarean section.
country: Sweden, the Netherlands and Republic of Ireland
